workarounds.symptom: bug: model usage close() drops a batch it still has budget to drain (master unit red)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(usage): repeat an expired usage attempt while close() still drains. Target files: src/powercontext/builtin/runtime/_model_usage.py, tests/builtin/runtime/test_model_usage_recorder.py. `_ModelUsageRecorder.close()` sets `_closed` before it waits for the drain. Once `_closed` was set, `_write` never repeated an SQLite attempt that expired before its body committed. So during shutdown a batch got only its first slice, a quarter of `write_timeout_seconds` (0.25 s by default), even though `close()` waits up to `write_t... (Ref: https://github.com/oceanbase/powercontext/pull/2706)
